title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: Think about what it means for two vectors to be orthogonal. If two vectors are orthogonal, their dot product is zero. Consider the vector $$1$$ and the vector Y-hat. What does their dot product tell you?

title: Exploring the Span
text: The span of a set of vectors is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. If a vector is in the span of another set of vectors, it can be expressed as a linear combination of them. Can the vector $$1$$ be expressed as a linear combination of the vectors in Y-hat?
